messages:
Alice M.: quick handoff — I'm primary wrapping up a short incident. Summary: 05:14–05:32 UTC we saw localized 503s for embeddings in eu-west caused by autoscaler thrash + a redis leader failover. Impact: intermittent 503s for a subset of low-volume customers, latency up for some requests. No high-sev customer pages yet.

oncall-bot: Pager triggered: EMBEDS_AUTOSCALER_THRASH (Sev3) — 5 pages in 20m. Link: https://incidents.internal/redwood/INC-2026-042 — paging group: @alice, @ben.

Alice M.: mitigations applied before handoff: pinned autoscaler replicas to 2, rolled back aggressive scale policy, routed a fraction (~10%) of eu-west traffic to embed-fallback-v1. Observability: dashboards updated (embedding-p95, 503-rate, autoscaler-events).

Ben K.: ack — taking primary. Immediate plan: 1) watch for new pages 2) restart autoscaler controller if JVM heap grows 3) stabilize redis leader. I'll run a controlled restart and watch metrics.

Ben K.: running now: ```kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/embed-autoscaler-controller && kubectl -n data rollout status sts/redis-leader-euw``` monitoring: dashboards + `logs -f` on controller.

Carla S.: I'll take secondary. I'll tail controller logs and watch embed-store errors, and open a customer-facing note if we see >1% 503 sustained. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/embed-autoscaler. Key pages: scaling thresholds, redis leader failover checklist.

Dan R.: quick note — one customer (acme-forms) reported latency spikes; recommendation: enable regional cache-priming for hot prefixes and temporarily divert their traffic to eu1-fallback. I can kick that route if Ben confirms autoscaler restart completed. Example curl to update route: ```curl -X POST https://routing.internal/rewrite -d '{"service":"embeds","from":"eu-west","to":"eu1-fallback","percent":100}'```

Ben K.: autoscaler restart finished, controller logs look healthy now. Redis leader elected cleanly per events log. 503-rate trending down to baseline. Will keep an eye for 30m.

Alice M.: thanks team. Action items for handoff: - Ben primary 2h monitoring (alerts: 503-rate > 0.5% sustained 5m) - Carla secondary to escalate to SEs + open ticket if any customer sees repeated errors - Dan to coordinate routing change if latency persists for acme-forms - I'll draft a short incident note after shift.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 transitioned to "monitoring" status by Ben K.

Ben K.: final update before handoff: 06:02 UTC — autoscaler stable, 503-rate back to normal, no new pages in last 25m. Keeping watch window open until 08:00 UTC. If anything reoccurs, escalate to platform@redwood and tag postmortem. :white_check_mark:

Alice M.: handed off. Ben you have the floor. Thanks all — short and tidy. :raised_hands:

Carla S.: noted, will kick off a retrospective doc if trend reappears. Adding runbook improvements: clearer healthchecks and a short playbook snippet to forcibly disable aggressive scale rules.

Dan R.: will be on-call for routing roll if Ben requests.

Ben K.: thanks — monitoring now.
